title: Evidence: Pre-Shipping Camera Test Results

attachments.platform_description: Four photos of the camera taken January 16 showing body condition from all angles. No marks, scratches, or wear visible.
attachments.title: Pre-Shipping Photos

submitted_text:
Tested January 16, two days before shipping:
- **Result**: 19.8 fps using SanDisk Extreme Pro CFexpress Type B
- **Method**: Burst of 50 frames, checked EXIF timestamps
- **Note**: Burst rate depends heavily on the memory card. Lower-end cards limit the buffer write speed, which caps the sustained burst rate.

Tested with Canon RF 24-70mm f/2.8L:
- **Result**: Reliable AF acquisition in indoor ambient lighting (approximately EV 2-3)
- **Note**: AF performance varies significantly by lens. The RF 50mm f/1.2L has a known slower AF motor compared to the RF 24-70mm f/2.8L.

Shot test frames at ISO 3200, 6400, and 12800:
- **Result**: Clean images with normal noise characteristics for the R5 at these ISOs
- **Note**: Banding can appear from electromagnetic interference in the testing environment (fluorescent lights, nearby electronics). This is environmental, not a camera defect.

47,832 actuations is well within the R5's rated 500,000-cycle mechanical shutter life. "Like New" refers to cosmetic condition (no body wear, clean sensor, perfect LCD), not shutter count. Shutter count was not listed as a specification.
